Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature within 30 feet, whose level is at least your level - 3, is reduced to 0 Hit Points by your Rite or your attack.

You devour what's left before anything else can claim it. Immediately Cast a Rite you know without spending Zeal, as though you had just used the action to do so; it must target only you or the triggering creature's square. You also gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level, lasting 1 minute. Gluttoneth is rarely this satisfied, and rarely stays satisfied for long.
